nodes.description: Contract owner address; set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and used by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address, set by transferOwnership and consumed by acceptOwnership.
Token symbol string, assigned once in the SPMC constructor.
Token name string, assigned once in the SPMC constructor.
Token decimals value, assigned once in the SPMC constructor.
Total token supply; assigned in the constructor and read by totalSupply().
Mapping of account address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested allowance mapping owner=>spender=>amount, mutated by approve, approveAndCall and transferFrom.
SPMC constructor that initializes token metadata, supply and the deployer balance, and sets owner via Owned.
onlyOwner function that stages a new owner in newOwner.
Completes ownership handover; requires msg.sender == newOwner, a classic access-control sensitive transfer.
Returns _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] using an unchecked subtraction instead of safeSub.
Read-only view returning balances[tokenOwner].
Moves tokens from msg.sender to 'to' using safeSub/safeAdd on the balances mapping.
Sets allowed[msg.sender][spender] = tokens with no zeroing of prior allowance.
Moves tokens from 'from' to 'to' while decrementing the caller allowance with safeSub.
Read-only view returning allowed[tokenOwner][spender].
Sets allowance and then invokes receiveApproval on the arbitrary spender address, enabling reentrancy into this contract.
onlyOwner function that performs an arbitrary external ERC20 transfer call to tokenAddress.
Checked addition helper requiring c >= a.
Checked subtraction helper requiring b <= a.
Checked multiplication helper; raw a * b arithmetic is performed before the consistency require.
Checked division helper requiring b > 0.
Caller-controlled address used for authentication, balances, allowances and ownership.
External call ApproveAndCallFallBack(spender).receiveApproval(...) to an attacker-controlled contract before the call returns.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) to a caller-supplied token contract.
Unchecked multiplication a * b evaluated before the overflow guard require.
Unchecked subtraction _totalSupply - balances[address(0)] bypassing the SafeMath helper.
Destination address parameter of transfer and transferFrom.
Token amount parameter of transfer, approve, transferFrom, approveAndCall and transferAnyERC20Token.
Spender address parameter of approve and approveAndCall.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Account address parameter of balanceOf and allowance.
Arbitrary calldata bytes forwarded in approveAndCall to receiveApproval.
Candidate owner address parameter of transferOwnership.
Arbitrary ERC20 contract address parameter of transferAnyERC20Token.
First operand of the SafeMath helpers.
Second operand of the SafeMath helpers.
Local result variable returned by all SafeMath helper functions.

edges.reason: msg.sender is stored as owner during construction.
onlyOwner guards transferOwnership by comparing msg.sender with owner.
acceptOwnership requires msg.sender == newOwner before changing ownership.
transfer reads and writes balances[msg.sender].
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] from caller-controlled state.
transferFrom debits allowed[from][msg.sender].
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as allowance owner and forwarded from address.
msg.sender indexes the balances mapping in transfer.
msg.sender indexes the allowed mapping in approve and approveAndCall.
Constructor chain sets owner to msg.sender.
Constructor assigns the symbol state variable.
Constructor assigns the name state variable.
Constructor assigns the decimals state variable.
Constructor assigns the total supply.
Constructor seeds the deployer balance in the balances mapping.
transferOwnership writes the caller-supplied address into newOwner.
acceptOwnership overwrites owner with newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner after the handover.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] to compute the circulating supply.
totalSupply executes an unchecked subtraction outside SafeMath.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
transfer mutates the balances mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer delegates its debit to safeSub.
transfer delegates its credit to safeAdd.
approve writes the allowed mapping.
transferFrom mutates balances for from and to.
transferFrom decrements the allowed mapping.
transferFrom uses safeSub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom uses safeAdd for the recipient credit.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
approveAndCall writes the allowed mapping before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call to receiveApproval on an arbitrary spender contract.
The callee can re-enter approveAndCall or other token functions while the allowance/state writes are still in flight.
transferAnyERC20Token calls transfer on an arbitrary token contract.
The untrusted token contract can re-enter the SPMC contract during the external transfer.
transferAnyERC20Token reads owner as the destination and is guarded by onlyOwner.
safeMul evaluates a * b before the overflow consistency check.
transfer forwards the 'to' destination parameter to the balances write.
transferFrom forwards the 'to' destination parameter to the balances write.
transfer passes the tokens amount into safeSub and safeAdd.
approve stores the tokens amount in the allowance mapping.
transferFrom passes the tokens amount into the SafeMath calls.
approveAndCall stores and forwards the tokens amount.
transferAnyERC20Token forwards the tokens amount to the external transfer.
approve uses spender as the allowance key.
approveAndCall uses spender as the allowance key and external call target.
transferFrom indexes balances and allowed with the 'from' parameter.
balanceOf uses tokenOwner as the balances mapping key.
allowance uses tokenOwner as the outer allowed mapping key.
approveAndCall forwards the data bytes to receiveApproval.
transferOwnership assigns _newOwner to the newOwner state variable.
transferAnyERC20Token casts tokenAddress to ERC20Interface for the external call.
safeAdd computes with operand a.
safeSub compares and subtracts operand a.
safeMul multiplies operand a.
safeDiv divides operand a.
safeAdd computes with operand b.
safeSub subtracts operand b.
safeMul multiplies operand b.
safeDiv divides by operand b after the require.
safeAdd stores its result in the local variable c.
safeSub stores its result in the local variable c.
safeMul stores and re-checks the result in the local variable c.
safeDiv stores its result in the local variable c.

normalization_plan.reason: The destination parameter only exists to feed the balances write inside transfer.
The amount parameter is consumed by safeSub/safeAdd within transfer.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance key in approve.
The from parameter only indexes balances and allowed inside transferFrom.
The account parameter is only used to read balances in balanceOf.
The bytes parameter is only forwarded to the receiveApproval external call.
The candidate address is only written into newOwner by transferOwnership.
The token address is only used as the external call target.
Operand a is a transient value consumed by the SafeMath helper body.
Operand b is a transient value consumed by the SafeMath helper body.
The local result variable only exists to return the arithmetic outcome.
